scope: Map Data city export frontend request/result contract

recovered.eligibility: frontend offers export only on the city tab; selected data server must be positive; button is disabled while a map scan is reading or export is already busy

query.source: the same current Map Data query builder used by search
query.implication: current city keyword/alliance/no-alliance/marked/sort state is serialized by the shared query builder when present

options.localization: translation keys are resolved by the frontend before invocation; literal X/Y/UID/UUID/HP remain literal

result.success: uses rowCount and path in the visible success message and log
result.failure: surfaces the thrown error through the panel error formatter and city-export log

implementation.behavior: a structurally recovered city-export envelope with page=1/pageSize=200 and resolved option strings reaches the existing MAP_INDEX_UNAVAILABLE writer gate; no workbook is created

validationAndLimits.validation: hash-locked static frontend verification plus deterministic fail-closed backend-envelope regression
unknownBlocked: native file picker contract and default filename/path
backend row-to-column value mapping and type coercion
whether the backend internally paginates beyond the frontend query pageSize=200
workbook library/format details, column widths/styles and exact cancellation/error codes
large UID/UUID preservation and reopen behavior in the original writer

implementationImpact.frontendEnvelope: exact request options and consumed result fields are now pinned
implementationImpact.backend: map_city_export remains unavailable until writer scope/row mapping/pagination/file-dialog semantics are recovered; the 200-row frontend query is not treated as proof of an export row limit
